popCulture.title: Aethalides (Argonaut)
popCulture.description: Son of Hermes and Eupolemia, herald of the Argonauts — gifted with an unforgetting soul that passes through countless lives.

popCulture.title: Argonautica
popCulture.creator: Apollonius of Rhodes
popCulture.description: Apollonius makes Aethalides the Argo's herald whose memory never dies — Hermes' gift as the voyage's living archive.

popCulture.title: Hermes
popCulture.description: Aethalides' father — the messenger god who bequeaths his son unbroken recollection across rebirths.

popCulture.title: Jason and the Argonauts
popCulture.creator: Don Chaffey / Ray Harryhausen
popCulture.description: The film that fixed the Argonaut crew in modern screens — Aethalides as the literary herald behind that company.
